_comment: Code-scanning alerts dismissed by .github/workflows/code-scanning.yml (contrib/secops/code-scanning-triage.py). One entry per tool + rule + path glob: reason is one of 'false positive', 'won't fix', 'used in tests'; comment is the argument a reviewer can check (280 characters reach GitHub). A real finding is fixed in code, never listed here.

dismissals.comment: yew-cli (developer/devnet driver) prints to its own stdout: addresses, txids, heights, birthday, amounts, derivation paths; key types have redacting Debug. The one secret, `export-wif <addr>`, prints the WIF because that is the command (as dumpprivkey). No log file.

Regtest devnet integration test: println/assert/panic messages print txids, addresses, heights, amounts and Debug of sync reports and plans of throwaway wallets made from fresh generate_mnemonic seeds; no mnemonic or key is printed. Never shipped.
Line 408 is a panic message in #[cfg(test)] mod tests (from line 358): Debug of a Funding plan (amounts, fees, inputs), no key material. yew-core has no logging in production code.
Line 757 is an assert message in #[cfg(test)] mod tests (from line 527): it prints the fee and size of a regtest quote, no key material. yew-core has no logging in production code.

183: b"Bitcoin seed" is the BIP32 master-key HMAC key fixed by the spec (the secret is the seed, the data). 216: chain_code = [0u8; 32] is a buffer initializer overwritten by the HMAC-SHA512 output on the next line.
260: b"yew-wrap" is a domain-separation label used as the HMAC key; the keying material is the BIP39 seed passed as the data (WrapSecret = HMAC-SHA256("yew-wrap", seed)). No secret is hard-coded.
251: h = [0u8; 20] in p2pkh_hash is a buffer overwritten by copy_from_slice from the script; the hash160 later reaches wrap_key's nonce parameter as a per-key nonce, never as the zero constant.
790/797: Ok(false)/Ok(true) is set_vault_activation's "parameters changed" flag; it is not used as a key.

1962-1966: wrap_key(b"k", b"n1", ..) in #[cfg(test)] wrap_is_symmetric_and_nonce_bound (the production callers in wallet.rs pass the seed-derived WrapSecret and the key's hash160). 762: meta_u64's default Ok(0) for a missing height/counter, not a key.

771: NistDrbg { key: [0; 32] } is the NIST KAT AES-CTR DRBG's specified initial state, in #[cfg(test)] mod tests (from line 623), immediately updated from the KAT seed; it reproduces the node's Falcon-512 KATs.
